forecasts.question: Will Iran resume negotiations with the US before EOD 2026-06-16?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO via ambiguity rule. Within the June 10-16 window: Pakistan PM Sharif announced agreement on 'final text' of MoU framework June 12; digital signing of MoU occurred June 14 (Trump at Versailles, Pezeshkian in Tehran) — but this was a remote/digital signature with no named convened session between US and Iranian principals/envoys. No TIER1 source confirmed a physically convened or formally mediated negotiating session with named US and Iranian officials meeting face-to-face or indirectly through a co-present mediator before June 16. Iranian MFA spokesman Baghaei confirmed the MoU via IRNA on June 17 — one day after the horizon. The June 21 Bürgenstock session falls outside the June 16 horizon. Per ambiguity rule: digital signing and text relay without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-06-16, a publicly confirmed HELD negotiating session (direct or mediated via Oman/Qatar/Pakistan) occurs between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, OR an official Iranian statement (MFA/state media IRNA/Tasnim/Fars) rescinds the 2026-06-01 suspension. A held mediated session counts; mere rhetorical assertion that 'talks continue' or relay of written messages does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official Iranian state-media; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also resolves.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Trump-only assertions without Iranian/mediator confirmation do NOT count; written-message exchanges that are not a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will a final Iran-US nuclear/ceasefire deal be signed before EOD 2026-09-15?
forecasts.delta_reason: New forecast. The June 17 Islamabad MoU established a 60-day roadmap (target: approximately August 16) with a High Level Committee and technical working groups on nuclear, sanctions, and monitoring established at the June 21-22 Bürgenstock Summit. Core unresolved issues remain: Iran's HEU stockpile disposition, enrichment levels, ballistic missile program (explicitly excluded from MoU), verification protocols (NPR June 23: 'US-Iran dispute over nuclear inspections clouds work to finalize a war-ending deal'), and IAEA physical return to Iranian nuclear sites (Fordow, Isfahan, Natanz). The June 28-29 new strikes and the volatile ceasefire trajectory further reduce the probability. p=0.30.
